definitions.explanation: Medicine taken to relieve constipation. The everyday, consumer-facing word — packaging at pharmacies and TV ads typically use this term rather than the medical {下剤|げざい}.

examples.japanese: {便秘薬|べんぴやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{便秘薬|べんぴやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a laxative at the pharmacy.

examples.japanese: {便秘薬|べんぴやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{使|つか}わ→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{食生活|しょくせいかつ}→食生活：21071_shokuseikatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧にした⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Rather than using a laxative every day, it's better to improve your diet first.

notes:
⟦{便秘|べんぴ}→便秘：05383_benpi⟧ (constipation) + {薬|やく} (medicine). The everyday consumer term — pharmacy shelves and TV commercials use this rather than the medical-register ⟦{下剤|げざい}→下剤：28835_gezai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {便秘薬|べんぴやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to take a laxative
- {便秘薬|べんぴやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧: to rely on laxatives
- ⟦{市販|しはん}→市販：12424_shihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{便秘薬|べんぴやく}: over-the-counter laxative

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{下剤|げざい}→下剤：28835_gezai⟧: laxative — medical register; used in clinical contexts
- ⟦{整腸|せいちょう}{剤|ざい}→整腸剤：22358_seichouzai⟧: digestive-regulating medicine — broader, also for diarrhea
- ⟦{便秘|べんぴ}→便秘：05383_benpi⟧: constipation (the condition itself)
